content.value_statement: Visual experiences can become inconsistent, slow, or inaccessible across pages. This skill guides animation, gallery, demo, and Three.js updates with clear safety constraints.
actual_capabilities: Defines scope for animation presets, registries, and orchestrator files.
Guides updates to inspiration, demos, and Visual Experience Engine pages.
Promotes accessible animation behavior, including reduced motion support.
Supports wiring animations into hero sections, cards, sections, and demos.
Covers Three.js visual components for managed 3D experiences.
limitations: It provides guidance only; it does not include executable implementation files.
It assumes the target project already contains the referenced visual engine paths.
It does not define testing commands or performance budgets.
It focuses on Synthex.social visual pages, not general site architecture.

use_cases.title: Add Page Animations
use_cases.description: Use the skill to add visual effects to landing pages while preserving accessibility and performance constraints.

use_cases.title: Review Visual Concepts
use_cases.description: Use the skill to align inspiration gallery and demo experiences with supported animation categories.

use_cases.title: Check Motion Safety
use_cases.description: Use the skill to verify reduced motion support, timing limits, and flashing restrictions before release.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Motion Safety
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the Visual Experience Engine changes for reduced motion support, flashing risks, and animation duration problems.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review before merging a small animation change.

prompt_templates.title: Add Animation Preset
prompt_templates.prompt: Add a new animation preset with a human-friendly name and wire it into the relevant visual registry and demo surface.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate update for a new reusable visual style.

prompt_templates.title: Extend Demo Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Update the demos page to show a new visual effect, including safe defaults and clear behavior for reduced motion users.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced page update that connects presets to user-facing demos.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Three.js Experience
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a Three.js visual component plan that fits the visual engine scope and avoids heavy blocking scripts.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning for managed 3D visual components.

output_examples.input: Add a new beam effect to the inspiration gallery.
output_examples.output: A scoped implementation plan that covers registry updates, page changes, reduced motion behavior, and visual QA steps.

output_examples.input: Review a proposed hero animation for launch.
output_examples.output: A practical review that flags motion safety, performance risks, page scope, and required accessibility checks.

output_examples.input: Create a 3D visual demo concept for the engine page.
output_examples.output: A concise concept plan with component scope, interaction behavior, performance safeguards, and demo placement.

best_practices: Start by mapping changes to the scoped visual engine files.
Check reduced motion behavior for every animation change.
Keep animation timing above 0.5 seconds and avoid rapid flashing.
anti_patterns: Adding heavy effects that block rendering.
Using disorienting zoom or rotation as a default interaction.
Changing unrelated pages outside the visual engine scope.

faq.question: What does this skill help build?
faq.answer: It helps extend visual animations, inspiration galleries, demos, and Three.js components for the Visual Experience Engine.

faq.question: Does it include executable code?
faq.answer: No. The skill provides instructions and scope guidance, not scripts or implementation files.

faq.question: Which accessibility concerns does it cover?
faq.answer: It requires reduced motion checks, avoids rapid flashing, and discourages disorienting motion.

faq.question: Can it support landing page effects?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers hero sections, cards, sections, and demos within the visual engine scope.

faq.question: Does it cover Three.js work?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes scope for visual Three.js components and managed 3D visual experiences.

faq.question: Who should use this skill?
faq.answer: Frontend developers, product designers, and accessibility reviewers working on visual experience pages can use it.
